blueprint.selection_reason: A comedic animated character short with voice-over narration; no product, try-on or unboxing template fits, so the free film is used. Borrowed rules: one place, one subject, visible end state per beat, original music bed under the voice.

brief.objective: A 30-second comedic animated roast of Dudi, a fictional larger-than-life businessman: his mind jumps from luxury plans to absurd penny-pinching. Key message: Dudi wants everything luxurious, but cheaper.
brief.audience: Friends of the creator, Hebrew speakers, watching on phones in a private chat.
brief.placement: WhatsApp and Instagram, vertical, watched with sound on.
brief.subject: Dudi, a fictional character (not a real person), in his own half-renovated luxury living room in Jerusalem.

visual_direction.concept: A high-end stylised 3D animated comedy short: a deadpan nature-documentary narrator describes Dudi as if he were a rare species. Each beat shows one absurd habit with a clear physical gag and end state; the payoff is Dudi bolting upright at night with yet another idea.
visual_direction.setting: Dudi's large living room in a Jerusalem stone house mid-renovation: warm Jerusalem-stone walls, a rounded white ceiling with a built-in warm LED cove, a half-finished marble floor with a stack of large square ceramic tiles leaning on the wall, a toolbox and a folded ladder in a corner, a deep velvet sofa, a low walnut coffee table, a tall window with arched frame. Everything stays in place all film.
visual_direction.look: Polished feature-animation 3D style: exaggerated proportions, big expressive eyes and eyebrows, soft subsurface skin, slightly glossy materials, saturated warm palette of terracotta, teal and gold, gentle depth of field. Light: the warm LED cove in the rounded ceiling, soft and even from above, plus a steady amber table lamp at screen right.
visual_direction.continuity: Dudi has the same face, huge black curled moustache, curly dark hair, red nose, navy three-piece suit, gold pocket square and gold-cased phone in every shot. The tiles, sofa, coffee table and window never move unless a hand moves them. The electrician appears only in beat 5.

storyboard.framing: Medium shot, Dudi centred in the living room, eye level, renovation visible behind him.
storyboard.action: Dudi twirls one end of his moustache with two fingers and lifts his chin proudly; ends holding the pose.
storyboard.lighting: Warm LED cove from above, amber lamp at right.

storyboard.framing: Medium-wide, Dudi walking between sofa and window, phone at ear.
storyboard.action: Dudi talks on the gold phone while 'flying' a small toy helicopter in his other hand in a loop through the air; ends holding the helicopter high, smiling dreamily.
storyboard.lighting: Same warm cove light, lamp at right.
storyboard.dialogue: עם הפרעת קשב ודרכון שווייצרי. בבוקר הוא שואל: כמה עולה מסוק בשווייץ?

storyboard.intention: Build: from helicopters to tiles in a small car.
storyboard.framing: Medium shot at the coffee table, a toy car and one large ceramic tile in frame.
storyboard.action: Dudi stretches a tape measure across the big tile leaning on the wall, then holds the tape over a small toy car on the coffee table and frowns at it; ends scratching his head.
storyboard.lighting: Same warm cove light, lamp at right.
storyboard.dialogue: חמש דקות אחר כך: האם קרמיקה מאה עשרים נכנסת בקיה?

storyboard.intention: Build: haggling on a huge deal like at a market.
storyboard.action: Dudi holds a small architectural model of an office tower in one hand and a ripe tomato in the other, weighs them up and down like a market scale, squints suspiciously; ends sniffing the tomato.
storyboard.lighting: Same warm cove light, lamp at right.
storyboard.dialogue: פרויקט של מאתיים מיליון? הוא מתמקח כמו על קילו עגבניות.

storyboard.framing: Two-shot by the window: an electrician in grey overalls with a tool belt at left, Dudi at right.
storyboard.action: The electrician hands Dudi a sheet of paper; Dudi takes it, reads, narrows his eyes and raises one finger; the electrician's shoulders drop.
storyboard.lighting: Same warm cove light, lamp at right.
storyboard.dialogue: ולחשמלאי הוא אומר: אפשר להוריד שלושים אחוז?

storyboard.action: Dudi lies asleep on the sofa snoring, moustache fluttering, then bolts upright, eyes wide, and grabs his gold phone from the coffee table; ends sitting upright holding the phone.
storyboard.camera_movement: Locked-off, then a quick push in as he sits up.
storyboard.lighting: Cove light dimmed low and warm, the amber lamp steady at right.
storyboard.dialogue: ובאמצע הלילה: רגע… יש לי עוד רעיון קטן.

storyboard.framing: Close-up on Dudi's face lit by the phone screen glow from below.
storyboard.action: Dudi types fast with both thumbs, moustache twitching with excitement, a mischievous grin spreading; holds the grin.
storyboard.lighting: Phone glow from below plus the dim amber lamp at right.

reference_images.description: Dudi, the fictional main character, generated as a character sheet for identity across all shots.
preserve_details: navy three-piece suit with gold pocket square

source.image_prompt: Polished 3D feature-animation character, full body, standing, neutral light grey background, soft studio light: a stocky cheerful Israeli businessman about 55 years old with a huge black curled handlebar moustache, curly dark hair, big expressive brown eyes, thick arched eyebrows, round red nose, wearing a tailored navy three-piece suit with a gold pocket square and polished brown shoes, holding a gold-cased smartphone. Exaggerated cartoon proportions, glossy materials, warm saturated colours. No text, no logos.

audio.accent: Russian accent, natural, as spoken by a native Russian speaker fluent in Hebrew
audio.voice_direction: Male narrator aged 55 to 65, deep and slightly gravelly, slow deadpan delivery like a serious nature documentary, short dry pauses before each punchline; never mocking or exaggerated.
audio.music: Original klezmer-cabaret bed, about 100 BPM in 2/4, clarinet lead with violin and accordion, light upright bass; quiet under the voice, a small clarinet flourish on each cut, drops to near silence as he sleeps in s6, a comic sting when he sits up, resolves softly at the end.
audio.ambience: Quiet room tone, footsteps on marble, tape measure snapping back, paper rustle in s5, soft snoring in s6, rapid phone taps in s7.

constraints: Dudi is a fictional character and must not resemble any real person.
No captions, subtitles, titles, watermarks or any lettering in the frame; no logos on the phone, car or clothes.
Only one place: Dudi's living room. The electrician appears only in s5.
No profanity in the spoken lines.
assumptions: The 3D feature-animation look follows the user's reference image, which was described in words because it could not be attached.
Episode 1 covers the opening of the user's text; the rest of the text is planned as later episodes.
On-screen captions such as 02:47 and censored swear words are added afterwards in editing, not inside the generated video.
The toy helicopter, toy car and tower model stand in for the Swiss helicopter, the Kia and the property deal so the film stays in one place.
